g.text: Saving settings: sanitise, validate, persist, apply
(clamp numbers, clean URLs, fill missing shortcut bindings)
rollback to prev (if seq is latest);
(a write error returns Err and the UI rolls back the same way)
(style -> StyleChanged; mode only when not live -> ModeChanged)
(restarts transcription sessions if that provider changed)
stored Settings (applied if seq is still latest)
Settings are stored as one JSON row in SQLite; API keys are never part of Settings (see the API-key diagram).
reset_settings builds Settings::default() (keeping onboarding_complete and profile) and goes through the same path.
